subject: Changed LUA module dependency (#3325)
reason: The change touches only build files (deps/lua/src/Makefile, src/Makefile, src/modules/lua/Makefile): it reorders the engine_lua.so build dependency so the Lua module is built as a prerequisite of valkey-server rather than after it, filters the module out of the server link inputs, and adds quiet pretty-printing to the Lua compile/link rules. No runtime code changes, so no command reply, replication, persistence, or crash path can differ between the two builds; any breakage would surface as a compile/link failure, which the fuzzer's build step already exercises. No scenario is needed.
